topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I found out today that someone has tattooed my artwork on their skin. It's an odd feeling, seeing something I created, something so personal, committing it to their body. I can't decide if it's flattering or just plain bizarre. Part of me is flattered, of course; it means they admire my work enough to wear it forever. But the other part... well, it's like a piece of me is out there, beyond my control, altered by the needle and the skin. I suppose I'll have to get used to it, but for now, I just can't shake the sense of intrusion.
